text:
Samir Khatri: FYI Nexa Bio flagged an unexpected $125 charge on their dedicated invoice (INV-2026-2107). They claim reserved commit should cover it. Can someone check?

Leah Gomez: Share the invoice lines? I can diff the commit allocation.

Samir Khatri: Quick excerpt: 
``nInvoice: INV-2026-2107
Account: nexa-bio (acct: nexa-042)
Commit: nexa-2026-H1 (1500.00 GPU-hours)
Lines:
  Reserved applied: 1495.00 GPU-hours
  Burst billed: 5.00 GPU-hours @ $25/hr -> $125.00
```

Billing Bot: Auto note 3:02 UTC metering window 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-15.

Tom Wu: Hmm 1495 + 5 = 1500, so usage totals match. Possible causes: late-region failover sending duplicate metering, or commit mapping not applied to some cross-region nodes.

Leah Gomez: Running a quick rollup by region: 
``nSELECT region, SUM(hours) as h FROM metering.usage WHERE account='nexa-042' AND time >= '2026-04-01' AND time < '2026-04-15' GROUP BY region;
```
Result: us-west-2: 900.00, eu-west-1: 600.00, ap-southeast-1: 0.00, us-east-1: 0.00 (but note: 5.00 recorded in region tag 'unknown')

Leah Gomez: There's a small 5.00h bucket with region=NULL and bucket=default. That explains the burst. I suspect a cloud vendor webhook for preemptible node termination didn't include region tag for a set of retries on 2026-04-03 around 02:10 UTC.

Cloud Vendor Bot: Alert: Duplicate attach/detach events observed 2026-04-03T02:08:57Z -> 2026-04-03T02:11:10Z for instance i-0abcd. Missing region metadata in third event. Vendor incident 4261-2026 acknowledges metadata loss during brief API outage.

Tom Wu: If vendor lost region metadata on those events, our metering pipeline would attribute usage to default (uncommitted) bucket. That matches the invoice. Engineering can reprocess if vendor provides the corrected event payloads.

Accounts Payable: For credits we need vendor confirmation + a regenerated reconciliation CSV. Alternatively we can issue a one-off goodwill credit of $125 if vendor turnaround will take >48h and customer is high-touch.

Samir Khatri: Nexa is enterprise and this is their production workload. Please try to get vendor payloads first, but if it drags, Leah/Finance can approve goodwill.

Leah Gomez: Reached out to vendor support and asked for the event payload dump for 2026-04-03 02:05-02:15 UTC. Also started a reprocess dry-run locally to see if remapping region would apply the 5.00h to the commit.

(20 minutes later)

Leah Gomez: Dry-run outcome: remapped 5.00h -> nexa-2026-H1 reserved bucket. No other differences. If vendor payloads confirm, this becomes a reprocess not a credit.

Cloud Vendor Bot: Support update: provided event dump and confirmed missing region metadata on third event. Payloads uploaded to s3://vendor-dumps/nexa/2026-04-03/events.jsonl.

Accounts Payable: Received vendor confirmation. We prefer reprocessing + regenerated invoice if possible. Please produce reconciliation CSV at s3://billing-recon/nexa/INV-2026-2107/reprocessed.csv and tag with who approved.

Samir Khatri: Tom/Leah, please run reproc and attach note of vendor incident ID 4261-2026. I'll notify Nexa and set expectation that we will update invoice/credit within 24h.

Tom Wu: Reprocess started. ETA ~45m. We'll include a short ops note explaining the region tag backfill and reference to vendor ticket.

(1 hour later)

Leah Gomez: Reprocessing complete. CSV uploaded: s3://billing-recon/nexa/INV-2026-2107/reprocessed.csv. Summary: reserved -> 1500.00, default -> 0.00. Burst removed.

Accounts Payable: Reviewed and approved. We will apply an invoice adjustment INV-2026-2107-ADJ1 to reflect reprocessed usage (remove $125). Adjustment posted; Nexa will see change in portal within 24h.

Samir Khatri: I'll send Nexa a short note: we reconciled, vendor confirmed event loss, reprocess applied, no charge. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

Leah Gomez: Filing a follow-up: add a validation in the commit reconciliation tool to flag non-region 'unknown' usage > 1 hour so these get surfaced automatically.

Accounts Payable: Noted. Closing thread after portal shows adjustment.

Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2026-2107 status updated -> ADJUSTED.
